verdict.rationale: DeepInfra documents a model lifecycle policy: at least one week's advance notice before deprecation, automatic forwarding of requests to a replacement model, and request-level version pinning via MODEL_NAME:VERSION. Its endpoints also sit under a /v1 path. However, nothing documents versioning or deprecation of the API surface itself, and probes found no deprecations page or changelog (both 404). missing for 10: API-surface/endpoint versioning policy, endpoint deprecation policy, API changelog, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: You'll receive at least 1 week's advance notice before the deprecation date
Point your existing OpenAI SDK to `https://api.deepinfra.com/v1/openai`
